an3.112:1.3: atīte bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:1.4: anāgate bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:1.5: paccuppanne bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:1.6: kathañca bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati :
an3.112:1.7: atīte bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
an3.112:1.8: tassa atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati.
an3.112:1.10: etamahaṃ bhikkhave, saññojanaṃ vadāmi yo cetaso sārāgo.
an3.112:1.11: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati :
an3.112:2.2: anāgate bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
an3.112:2.3: tassa anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati.
an3.112:2.5: etamahaṃ bhikkhave, saññojanaṃ vadāmi yo cetaso sārāgo.
an3.112:2.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave, paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati :
an3.112:3.2: paccuppanne bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti.
an3.112:3.3: tassa paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato chando jāyati.
an3.112:3.5: etamahaṃ bhikkhave, saññojanaṃ vadāmi. yo cetaso sārāgo.
an3.112:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, paccuppanne chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando jāyati.
an3.112:3.7: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāyāti.
an3.112:4.3: atīte bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
an3.112:4.4: anāgate bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.

an3.112:5.2: atītānaṃ bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti.
an3.112:5.4: tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
an3.112:5.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, atīte chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati.
an3.112:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave, anāgate chandarāgaṭṭhānīye dhamme ārabbha chando na jāyati :

an3.112:6.4: tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.

an3.112:7.2: paccuppannānaṃ bhikkhave, chandarāgaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ āyatiṃ vipākaṃ pajānāti. āyatiṃ vipākaṃ viditvā tadabhinivajjeti. tadabhinivajjetvā cetasā abhivirājetvā paññāya ativijjha passati.
